title: ERP Data Migration Analyst
text: ERP Data Migration Analyst at Uniting (Sydney, ; Contract/Temp; salary: not stated). About the opportunity This is a senior role within the Back Office ERP Program and is responsible for working with the Data Migration Specialist (Architect) and stakeholders to identify data to be migrated from legacy systems for Finance (AX2009), Procurement (Basware) and HR data (Preceda) to Azure cloud based environment for D365 and Talent. Role Objectives: Proven experience in Data Quality assessments and Data Mapping Experienced in SQL Server databases Demonstrated, solid SQL – script writing and stored procedure capabilities Experience in testing of data related solution components including data migration Demonstrated experience working on large data migration projects, including the investigation and analysis of key data sets and their relationships Qualifications Possess a suitable / relevant tertiary qualifications in Finance/IT OR relevant professional experience Experience & Skills 15 years’ experience as working as a Data Analyst Proven track record of working on Data migration and transformation of data from Financial ERP systems Demonstrate experience that shows you are at ease working in an advanced agile environment Experienced on Microsoft AX implementation projects preferably Dynamics 365 fOps Proven analytical and documentation skills that will ensure we create high quality documentation and solutions Strong communication and collaboration skills – ability to communicate effectively and professionally with other team members and customers Time management skills and ability to set priorities, plan and organise – you are highly structured with an eye for detail and take pride in "on-time, every-time" delivery Ability to work flexibly in an exciting and rapidly changing environment Proficient in the use of analytic tools such as analysis, spread-sheets, flow-charting and process diagramming Proven experience in Data Quality assessments and Data Mapping Experienced in SQL Server databases Demonstrated, solid SQL – script writing and stored procedure capabilities Even Better Possess Experience/Skill in Agile methodology Possess AX functional knowledge in other areas, for example Procurement and HR Experience in not for profit sector Benefits & culture Uniting is proud to be an EEO employer. Uniting supports an inclusive approach in the workplace. We celebrate our diversity and welcome staff regardless of ethnicity, faith, sexual orientation, gender identity and lifestyle choices. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people are encouraged to apply.
